inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: During the investigation, it was determined a caregiver used cruel and unusual punishment by yelling and using inappropriate language towards the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Release of Children: The investigation revealed that operation staff attempted to prevent a parent from leaving with their children in the absence of a court order.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4101(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One of ten children's records audited did not have immunizaitons on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: Four of ten personnel records audited did not have proof of educational requirements on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information gathered, a child was able to exit their classroom to the playground unsupervised on two occasions. Also, video evidence provided shows a caregiver videoing children and failing to intervene while children are seen climbing furniture.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on information gathered through interviews and video evidence, it was determined that staff members have grabbed and pulled children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Management failed to deliver form 2866 child interview letter to the parents of two children interviewed by Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on information gathered, a child was able to exit their classroom to the playground unsupervised on two occasions. These incidents were not reported to Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on video evidence provided, a caregiver did not demonstrate good judgement when she recorded children when she was supposed to be supervising them and recorded them without the consent of the parents or guardians.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: At time of inspection operation was observed with debrins in the classroom cabinets and diaper changing tables.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: At time of inspection, a toddler caregiver stated class had eleven children when they had twelve.          This was corrected at time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: At time of inspection a toddler caregiver did not conduct handwashing after diaper change of a child.     This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: At time of inspection a toddler caregiver did not conduct handwashing after diaper change of a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: At time of inspection, a toddler caregiver stated class had six children when they had seven.     At time of inspection, a toddler caregiver stated they had seven children when they had eight.     This was corrected at time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: At time of inspection, five out of ten children files did not have admission date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: At time of inspection, one out of ten staff files did not have a current CPR/First Aid certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: At time of inspection, three out of ten children files did not have immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: At time of inspection, two out of ten staff files did not have pre-service certificate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: During inspection, the trashcan in the school-aged classroom did not have a lid on it and was used to dispose of food.     Corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: At time of inspection, a diaper rash spray was observed in drawer at childs reach in childrens restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: At time of inspection, two staff files did not have verification of completing operation orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Fed in Safe Manner: At time of inspection, two infants, seven and eight months were observed laying flat on the rug while drinking formula.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Fed in Safe Manner (26 TAC §746.2419(5))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the inspection, the diaper changing station was noted to have debris present.     During the inspection, it was noted that the classroom floors contained debris.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: At time of inspection, cots were observed to not be labeled/assigned to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During a DFPS investigation it was determined that the center director demonstrated poor judgment when she interviewed a child involved in an incident in front of the parents of other children involved in the incident without the permission of that child?s parent. Further, she allowed those parents to ask the child questions about the incident and what led up to it. The parents who were present could have presented a risk to the child due to the highly emotionally charged atmosphere surrounding the incident, as well as the director failing to protect the child?s individual privacy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Provide Access to Children's Records - Licensing: During the course of a DFPS investigation, the operation was unable to provide an enrollment packet/required file for a child subject to the investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Access to Children's Records - Licensing (26 TAC §746.601(c))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: During an inspection conducted as part of a DFPS investigation, the school age classroom was observed to be chaotic and out of control.  Caregivers failed to intervene effectively to ensure children were behaving in a safe manner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the course of a DFPS investigation it was determined that a caregiver failed to adequately supervise children in her care resulting in an incident involving children engaging in inappropriate behavior.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Operation failed to provide a written incident report regarding a situation that placed children at risk to the parents of the children involved in the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not demonstrate good judgment when giving two children ice coffee.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The after-school caregiver stated there were 13 children on the playground before we verified there were 14 in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The teacher in the PreK classroom stated there were 20 children in care when we verified to be 21 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on information gathered during a DFPS investigation, a caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the back of the shirt near their neck, the caregiver further admitted to doing so while trying to correct the child's behavior.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: The operation failed to notify the parent of the allegations that involved a caregiver grabbing their child by the back of the shirt near the neck as a form of discipline. The parent was not notified of the allegations until the CCI Inspector made contact with that parent that their child was subject of an investigation regarding possible allegations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: In the Prek4 and Toddler classroom two radio extension cords were dangling which were accessible to the children.     NOTE: CORRECTED AT INSPECTION
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: After a diaper change in the infant classroom the child wasn't taken to wash hands.    In the Prek4 classroom after the teacher assisted a child with a change of clothes after having an accident the teacher nor child washed hands.     NOTE: CORRECTED AT INSPECTION.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on information gathered, and interviews conducted it was determined the caregiver in the school-age classroom grabbed a child from around the waist lifting the child to the front door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: At time of inspection, an infant teacher did not wash childs hands after diaper changing.     This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: An eight-month-old infant was observed sleeping in the crib with the pacifier in their mouth with a pacifier clip attached to the clothing.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when the pacifier clip was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: In the infant classroom a four-month-old was observed in the same classroom with a 23-month-old. This is a 19-month age difference.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children: Based on the information gathered, observation and interviews conducted the children are not being offered an alternative quiet activity while waiting on their cots while others are sleeping.     NOTE: This was corrected after another walkthrough was conducted as children had books.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children (26 TAC §746.2907(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A caregiver was observed allowing infants aged 14-22 months view a tablet with a screen time activity.  The screen time activity was while  children were eating their lunch.   NOTE;  This was corrected during inspection as the caregiver turned off the program when she was informed that screen time was prohitted for children under the age of 24 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the investigation it was determined that a group of children were left unsupervised in a classroom for somewhere between five to ten minutes when caregivers failed to communicate to one another their intention to leave the classroom briefly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: During the investigation, it was determined that no incident reports were completed or provided to parents regarding the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: During this investigation, it was determined that parents were not notified of incident that may have placed children at risk while at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Five of the ten children files did not have updated immunization records.     NOTE: One of the five immunization records was updated at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: One of the four children with diagnosed food allergies didn't have an Emergency Action Plan available in child's file. In addition to an Allergy and Dietary Preference List posted.    One of the ten children didn't have Emergency Authorization information available for review.      NOTE: Emergency Authorization information was corrected at inspection when provided electronically.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: On 3/17/2023 there were 25 children in the care of one caregiver with a specified age group of four.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment: A toilet was observed to have excrement on the seat. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver cleaned and sanitized the seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(11))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: In one room children were not sleeping on their assigned cots and an assignment map was not available in another room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: After having their diaper changed a child's hands were not washed. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver washed the child's hands and the hands of another child who had their diaper changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: One of the caregivers involved did not have current CPR and First Aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: The sink identified for hand washing only was being used for washing infants cups, spoons, and plates. The sink was cleared, infants plates, bottles, and plates were removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: Minibus #10277 child alarm system was tested and did not activate during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: A 16 month old infant was observed walking around while drinking a bottle.     Note: This was corrected at inspection as the caregiver seated the child in a highchair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: A caregiver did not interact in a positive manner when they forcefully grabbed and picked up a child during redirection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(7))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The fire inspection was expired at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed: The incident report was not signed by the parent within 48 hours of incident where a child was injured and required medical treatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed (26 TAC §746.705)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Based on the information gathered, the two caregivers were tending to one child on the playground to get the child ready to go home when a child fell off the playground structure and was injured.  Both caregivers, had their backs turned and did not see the child fall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment: Based on the information gathered the area was not disinfected and sanitized when a child was injured and required medical treatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(11))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: A caregiver left children unsupervised on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages: Caregivers in the infant room did not know ages of the children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages (26 TAC §746.1203(3))
